items.title: ‘Stay optimistic’: Career advice from the outgoing CSO of IKEA’s largest retailer
items.summary: Karen Pflug, chief sustainability officer at IKEA’s largest retailer, Ingka Group, is leaving the company at the end of December after 12 years.

items.title: Suntory publishes first Climate Transition Plan
items.summary: Suntory Beverage & Food Europe has published its first Climate Transition Plan, setting out measures to reduce emissions across its operations and value chain and achieve net-zero by 2050 or sooner.

items.title: EU proposes one-year delay to methane rules for fossil fuel imports
items.summary: The European Commission has proposed postponing methane reporting and verification requirements for imported fossil fuels by one year, citing concerns over energy supply disruption and implementation of the rules.

items.title: COP17 on desertification: What happened and what comes next?
items.summary: With the second summit of this tri-COP year starting on 19 October, edie gets you up to speed on everything you need to know from the seventeenth Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD COP17).

items.title: UK Government unveils action plan to boost organic farming
items.summary: As climate extremes intensify pressure on UK food resilience, the Government’s new action plan aims to expand organic farming, strengthen domestic supply chains and boost consumer demand.

items.title: ONE DAY LEFT to nominate for edie’s 30 Under 30 class of 2027
items.summary: Time is running out to nominate for edie’s next 30 Under 30 cohort, an initiative that celebrates the rising stars driving meaningful change across business.

items.title: Slowing the flow: Why flood resilience is becoming nature’s first investable asset
items.summary: Insurers can see the flood risk coming, and they hold the capital to address it. What is missing is the contract.

items.title: IN TWO WEEKS: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, sustainability professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.
